entities_by_identity_concept.identity_concept: Governed organization identifier, independent of any natural name or physical key.
Governed organization identifier specialized as a club.
Governed organization identifier specialized as a jurisdictional association.
Governed person identifier; a person is never equal to an account or a membership.
External authentication subject reference; not a person and not an authority.
Membership fact linking a person to an organization; not an authority.
Delegation fact; distinct from membership and from role labels.
Assignment fact; distinct from a reviewer role.
Governed jurisdiction identifier.
Governed season identifier with unique boundaries.
Policy identifier plus governed version.
Requirement identifier plus governed version, bound to a policy version.
Governed case identifier scoped to organization and season.
Governed pathway identifier applicable to a case.
Governed response identifier bound to a case and requirement version.
Governed evidence-metadata identifier referencing an external binary.
Governed decision-record identifier bound to a case.
Governed fee-obligation identifier scoped to a case and season.
External payment reference; not an accounting confirmation.
External accounting reference distinct from payment acknowledgement.
Governed reconciliation identifier.
Governed activation identifier bound to a case.
Case identifier plus governed state; state is a record, not a mutable field.
Governed snapshot identifier bound to a case and submission time.
Governed audit-event identifier; append-only and never mutated.
Governed lineage identifier linking a derived product to its source.
Governed correction identifier referencing the superseded fact.
